adjudication.rationale: In GoogleCalendarService.updateEvent and deleteEvent, the fallback branch when `externalCalendarId` is falsy is `event.destinationCalendar?.find((cal) => cal.externalId === externalCalendarId)?.externalId`. Because this branch only runs when `externalCalendarId` is falsy (undefined/null/empty), the predicate compares `cal.externalId` to a falsy value and will not match any real calendar externalId, returning undefined. This regresses the prior behavior (fallback to the event’s destination calendar externalId) and can cause update/delete to lose the intended calendar selection (silently resolving to undefined / defaulting behavior).
